notes: Maker page is the Skitch 1.1 (2026) Apex Flat Bar, Carbon CC; it contradicts itself on battery (spec 'Fazua 480Wh Integrated Battery' vs feature '430 Wh Battery'). Mike's sells this as 'Skitch Apex Flat Bar (480 Wh)' at $6,499 and a separate 430 Wh version at $6,399. No torque, range or max load on either page. Evo/competitivecyclist pages were the 2025 version or blocked (403). One WebSearch used. Size-guide quote is from the page's size guide (hidden pop-up text). recheck: maker page full text incl. FAQ (no range/torque stated; FAQ says US Class 3, 28 mph), Fazua Ride 60 manual PDF on maker site (60 Nm max), Upway Skitch review (60Nm, 480Wh, claimed up to 75 mi; its comparison table says 430Wh, so it is not fully consistent), Electric Bike Report first look (60Nm, '60 mi. or more' range, but for the original 430Wh Skitch, so not used for range), Contender Bicycles pages 404, 1 WebSearch shared across the four Skitch builds.
